proof_summary: For each prime-power layer, the numerator contributes \(\lfloor n/p^i\rfloor^2\), while the denominator contributes \(S(\lfloor n/p^i\rfloor)\), where \(S(m)=\sum_{k=1}^m k\lfloor m/k\rfloor\). The bound \(S(m)\le m^2\), with equality exactly for \(m\le2\) and strict inequality for \(m\ge3\), proves exact divisibility and makes the quotient’s \(p\)-adic valuation positive exactly when \(\lfloor n/p\rfloor\ge3\), equivalently \(p\le\lfloor n/3\rfloor\).
